article.title: a word of unusual size
article.content:
one abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabc is twenty-nine, below the body threshold abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcd is thirty, exactly the body threshold abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcd​e is thirty-one, one over the body threshold abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcd​e​f is thirty-two, two over the body threshold Pneumonoultramicroscopicsilico​v​o​l​c​a​n​o​c​o​n​i​o​s​i​s​a​n​d​t​h​e​n​s​o​m​e is fifty-six, a lot over chocolate/cappuccinos is twenty-one, and stays whole in body text 123456789012345678901234567890​1​2​3​4​5​6​7​8​9​0 is a forty character number Donaudampfschifffahrtsgesellsc​h​a​f​t​s​k​a​p​i​t​ä​n has a non-ascii character abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcd. is thirty-one only because of its period, so it cannot break abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcd​e​f​g​h​i. is thirty-six, and must not break before its period abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcd​e​f​g​h!? must not break before either of its last two characters (abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabc​d​e​f​g) counts its brackets, but will not break before the last one !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! is thirty-six characters of pure punctuation abcdefghijklmnoabcdefghijklmno​p​q​r​s​t is thirty-five across an em tag abcdefghijabcdefghijabcdefghij​k​l​m​n​o is thirty-five across three tags abcdefghijabcdefghijklmno is only twenty-five across an em tag, so it is left alone
abcdefghijklmno
abcdefghijklmnopqrst abcdefghijklmno
abcdefghijklmnopqrst is split by a line break, not an inline tag www.anextremelylongdomainnamethatgoesonandon.com is recognised as a link https://example.org/a/very/long/path/indeed keeps its scheme and stays whole arxiv.org/abs/2401.12345v2 and bit.ly/averylongshortenedlink have no scheme someone.withaverylongname@uwaterloo.ca is an email address https://example.org/a/long/path is a URL split across an em tag an anchor tag whose abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefghi is left alone http://mathnews.uwaterloo.ca/issue/v1xxiy/a-long-article-slug is a URL whose first half is recognised as a link text anchorabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefghijklmn is a long word glued to anchor text, so it counts as part of the link and stays whole example.net/a/long/path/the/old/regex/missed is recognised now that the TLD list is fixed notaurl.butaverylongwordindeed​y​e​s only looks a little like a domain a footnote1 1 https://example.org/a/very/long/footnoted/url
